mesa_runner.status.get_model_status(model_id, repo, *, live_registry=None)[source]

Return best-available status for one model by merging multiple sources.

Merge precedence:

  1. LiveProcessRegistry (if process is currently alive)

  2. Model row current snapshot

  3. Latest state transition

  4. Latest run terminal data

Raises:

KeyError if no information exists in any source for the given model_id. –

Parameters:

  • model_id (str)

  • repo (RunRepository)

  • live_registry (LiveProcessRegistry | None)

Return type:

ModelStatusView

This function is intended as the canonical single-model status resolver.

mesa_runner.status.list_active_status(repo, *, live_registry=None)[source]

Return status rows for models that are likely active.

Selection criteria:

  • Any model currently alive in LiveProcessRegistry.

  • Any model whose persisted state is queued, preparing, or running.

  • The returned rows are resolved through get_model_status to ensure the same

    merge logic and field semantics as single-model queries.

Parameters:

  • repo (RunRepository)

  • live_registry (LiveProcessRegistry | None)

Return type:

list[ModelStatusView]

mesa_runner.status.list_models_status_snapshot(repo, *, live_registry=None)[source]

Return a deterministic full snapshot for all models known to the repository.

Behavior:

  • Produces one ModelStatusView per persisted model row.

  • Enriches each row with live process data when available.

  • Sorts output by model_name (case-insensitive), then model_id.

This is suitable for dashboards, periodic reporting, and table displays.

Parameters:

  • repo (RunRepository)

  • live_registry (LiveProcessRegistry | None)

Return type:

list[ModelStatusView]

mesa_runner.status.live_status(repo, *, live_registry=None, interval_seconds=3.0, clear_screen=False)[source]

Print a continuously updating status view for all models.

This convenience function consumes stream_models_status and prints compact rows containing model name, state, pid, and return code.

Control:

  • Stops on keyboard interrupt: Stop with Ctrl+C (Linux) or Cmd+. (MacOS).

  • Optional clear_screen mode redraws in-place style output.

Parameters:

  • repo (RunRepository)

  • live_registry (LiveProcessRegistry | None)

  • interval_seconds (float)

  • clear_screen (bool)

Return type:

None

mesa_runner.status.reconcile_stale_runs(repo, *, stale_states=None, terminal_state='cancelled', reason='Reconciled: process not found after interruption.')[source]

Mark stale ‘running’ models as terminal if their PID is no longer alive.

Call this after an interrupted grid run to clean up stale DB state. Returns a list of model_ids that were reconciled.

Parameters:

  • repo (RunRepository) – RunRepository to read from and write corrections to.

  • stale_states (set[str] | None) – Set of state labels to consider for reconciliation. Defaults to {“running”, “preparing”}.

  • terminal_state (str) – State to write for stale models. Default “cancelled”.

  • reason (str) – Reason string written to the state transition record.

Returns:

List of model_ids that were corrected.

Return type:

list[str]

mesa_runner.status.stream_models_status(repo, *, live_registry=None, interval_seconds=2.0)[source]

Yield repeated all-model snapshots at a fixed polling interval.

Parameters:

  • interval_seconds (float) – Refresh interval, must be greater than zero.

  • repo (RunRepository)

  • live_registry (LiveProcessRegistry | None)

Yields:

List of ModelStatusView objects from list_models_status_snapshot.

Use this generator as the backend for custom live monitors.
